# The world an interleaving builds

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`the-world-an-interleaving-builds` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](the-world-an-interleaving-builds.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> From a local law and a list of exchanges a World of the spine is built whose steps balance. For any two interleavings of the same own courses an index map for each relatum matches its standings step by step, so what is read through its own steps is the same for every interleaving.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. The configuration after the first t exchanges of a list changes across step t by the exchange at t, is the whole list's from its length on, is unchanged up to a list's length by appending, is after a list the rest's from where the list ends, and agrees where the starts agree. (`Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.exchangeAt`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.runUpTo`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.runUpTo_succ`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.runUpTo_whole`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.runUpTo_append_le`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.runUpTo_append`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.runUpTo_agree`)
2. The world of a local law on whole-number standings, the relata listed, a list and a start: at step t each relatum stands where the first t exchanges leave it, is active where the exchange at t touches it, and the move at t has present the listed relata it touches, each taking its fall and giving its rise; nothing is required, needed or drawn. (`Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.touchedIn`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.fall`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.rise`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.world`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.world_level`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.touchedIn_mem`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.touchedIn_not_mem`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.touchedIn_mem_of`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.touchedIn_pairwise`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.total_zero_of`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.total_single`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.total_absent`)
3. With every relatum listed once, every step of the world balances: the standing after the step with what the relatum took is the standing before with what it gave. (`Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.world_balances`)
4. A relatum's course of standings is its standing after each exchange of its own course, in order. Moving an exchange forward past exchanges sharing no relatum with it keeps every course of standings, so with the relata listed two lists giving every relatum the same own course, and two interleavings of the same courses, give every relatum the same course of standings. (`Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.standings`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.standings_true`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.standings_false`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.standings_agree`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.standings_move`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.standings_idle`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.standings_of_courses`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.standings_of_interleavings`)
5. With the relata listed, the worlds of two lists giving every relatum the same own course stand alike at every step from both lengths on. (`Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.world_final`)
6. Two adjacent exchanges sharing no relatum, taken in either order, leave the worlds alike at every step but the one between them; there a relatum the first touches stands, in the world taking it first, where it stands after both in the other, and where it stood before both in the other; one neither touches stands alike. (`Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.world_swap`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.world_swap_between`)
7. A relatum's standing at step t of a list is its standing after the own exchanges the first t exchanges hold (ownCount, standingAfter). So in two interleavings of the same courses, with the relata listed, a relatum stands alike at any two steps, one in each world, at which it has taken equally many of its own exchanges. (`Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.ownCount`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.standingAfter`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.ownCount_true`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.ownCount_false`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.ownCount_zero`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.runUpTo_own`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.standingAfter_of_interleavings`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.runUpTo_of_own`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.world_own`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.world_of_own`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.afterOwn`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.afterOwn_zero`)
8. The index map for a relatum sends a step of one list to the least step of the other at which the relatum has taken as many of its own exchanges (firstAt is that least step; ownCount_index); a relatum stands at step t of one world where it stands at the mapped step of the other. Where it takes an exchange at step t of one list, the map sends t + 1 to the step after the one at which it takes the same exchange in the other. (`Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.ownCount_le`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.firstAt`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.firstAt_true`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.firstAt_false`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.ownCount_firstAt`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.firstAt_least`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.indexMap`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.length_of_interleavings`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.ownCount_index`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.runUpTo_index`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.world_index`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.exchangeAt_lt`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.exchangeAt_own`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.firstAt_succ_step`, `Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.index_matches`)
9. What is read through a relatum's own steps is the same for every interleaving: for every property of a standing, a relatum has it at some step of one world exactly where at some step of the other, and at every step of one exactly where at every step of the other. (`Becoming.Interleavings.LocalLaw.world_reads_alike`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. A local law on whole-number standings for the world (the laws of own steps hold for any states); the relata listed, once where balance is stated; relata told apart for the move. The courses are finite lists.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- One renumbering of all the steps carrying one interleaving's world to the other's: the index maps are one for each relatum, and a relation reading two relata at one step of the shared index (which stand together at a step) is not shown the same for every interleaving.
- The correspondence with the footprint of Becoming.Reordering (Footprinted, Reindexes, converse): there a relatum a step does not touch is unmoved across it, activity included, while this world marks a relatum active exactly at the steps whose exchange touches it, so the footprint of the exchanges does not contain them; and Reindexes needs each exchange's occurrence matched in the two lists, which needs the maps of the relata an exchange touches to agree.
- Courses without end; footprints that read relata they do not change.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Stated for discrete steps. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.

<details><summary>Correspondence, dependencies, sources and history</summary>

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

The twentieth review's G10 asked that Interleavings, which reads the step index off the relata's own courses, construct the World, so that one shared index is a reading on the premise card. Reading (the AI's): the spine's World, with its one index, is what an interleaving of the relata's own courses builds; what the interleaving adds beyond the courses moves only where exchanges share no relatum, and there each relatum stands in one world where it stands a step earlier or later in the other. With the index map (R38), what the world says of each relatum, read through its own steps, is the same for every interleaving: the premise card's one shared index (§0, block A) commits, for what is read per relatum, to no more than a choice among interleavings, which moves where on the index a standing falls and not which standings a relatum passes through or in what order. For the necessity target (the deductive necessity of the whole, item 1 of §8.1, and the representation criterion K4) this makes the shared index a reading wherever a law is read through each relatum's own steps; a law that reads several relata at one step of the index is still read on a chosen interleaving, which is what one renumbering of the steps would settle.
